name: After § 22
title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 22a. Calls on the Ombudsman to assess the effects of the EU Digital Services Act1a on freedom of expression; protests against the numerous cases of censorship under the guise of fighting fake news; 1a Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 19 October 2022 on a Single Market For Digital Services and amending Directive 2000/31/EC (Digital Services Act) (OJ L 277, 27.10.2022, p. 1, ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2022/2065/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2022/2065/oj)).
